our-story.title: Our story
our-story.intro: How a family outfit became one of Kenyir's most-loved cruise operators.

beginnings.title: Beginnings (2016)
beginnings.body: Summer Cruise began with one boat, one family, and a simple idea: the best way to feel Kenyir Lake is slowly, from the water.

growth.title: Green Horizon joins (2021)
growth.body: A second, larger vessel let us welcome bigger families and private groups without losing the quiet, personal feel.

today.title: Today
today.body: Two vessels, a crew of twelve — many from villages around the lake — and thousands of guests who arrived as strangers and left as friends.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.intro: The lake gives us everything. Here's how we give back.

lake.title: Lake conservation
lake.body: No single-use plastics on board, greywater managed at the jetty, and a monthly crew clean-up of shoreline sites we visit.

community.title: Community
community.body: Most of our crew live around Kenyir. We buy fish, fruit and crafts from village cooperatives, and every charter contributes to the local school fund.

wildlife.title: Wildlife first
wildlife.body: We follow a strict wildlife-watching code: no feeding, no baiting, engine-off near nesting sites, and night sounds kept low.

safety-and-wellbeing.title: Safety & wellbeing
safety-and-wellbeing.intro: Plain-language answers to “is it safe?” — yes, and here's exactly why.

crew.title: Trained crew
crew.body: Every crew member is certified in first aid and water rescue, and re-certified every year. A licensed captain is on board at all times.

equipment.title: On board every vessel
equipment.body: Life jackets for every guest (including children's sizes), fire extinguishers in every room, satellite phone, first-aid station, and life rafts rated beyond capacity.

weather.title: Weather calls
weather.body: We check the forecast with the meteorology department twice daily. If weather turns, we reroute to sheltered inlets — your safety beats your schedule, every time.

dining-and-cuisine.title: Dining & cuisine
dining-and-cuisine.intro: Fresh, generous Terengganu cooking — served on the deck, lake all around.

meals.title: Meals on board
meals.body: All packages are full board: breakfast, lunch, tea and dinner. Expect Terengganu classics — fresh lake fish, keropok lekor, gulai terung — cooked by our on-board chefs.

dietary.title: Dietary needs
dietary.body: Tell us when you enquire: vegetarian, halal (always), kids' portions, allergies. Everything is prepared fresh in our galley.

occasions.title: Occasions
occasions.body: Birthdays, anniversaries, proposals — tell us and the crew will set the deck with cake, lanterns and a view that does the rest.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Booking with us is simple — five steps, no account needed.

browse.title: 1. Browse
browse.body: Look through our packages and offers online — no sign-up, no pressure.

enquire.title: 2. Enquire
enquire.body: Send the form here, message us on WhatsApp, or just call. Whichever you prefer.

quote.title: 3. Get your quote
quote.body: We send your personalised quote — by WhatsApp, email or phone, your choice.

confirm.title: 4. Confirm & pay
confirm.body: Happy with it? We send simple payment instructions. Bank transfer, card or cash at our office.

board.title: 5. Check in & board
board.body: Arrive at the jetty, show your booking code, step on board. That's it.

account.q: Do I need to create an account?
account.a: No. You never need an account to browse, enquire, book or check in.

whatsapp.q: Can I book entirely through WhatsApp?
whatsapp.a: Yes. Many of our guests do exactly that — from first question to boarding.

language.q: Can I talk to someone in Bahasa Malaysia?
language.a: Tentu boleh! Our whole team speaks Bahasa Malaysia and English.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
body: We collect only what we need to answer your enquiry or run your booking: your name, phone number, email, travel dates and party size. We never sell your data, and we never share it with anyone except the partners directly involved in your trip (for example, our jetty transfer provider).
Your enquiry details are kept for up to 24 months so we can help you quickly if you come back. You can ask us to delete them at any time — WhatsApp or email us and it's done within 7 days.
Our website uses a small cookie to remember your language choice (English or Bahasa Malaysia). Nothing else is tracked, and no advertising cookies are used.
Questions about your data? Email hello@summercruise.example or message us on WhatsApp — a person, not a bot, will answer.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
body: A booking is confirmed once we receive a 30% deposit. The balance is due 14 days before departure. Prices shown on this website are indicative until you receive a written quote from our team.

Cancellations made more than 30 days before departure receive a full refund of the deposit. Between 14–30 days, 50% of the deposit is refundable. Within 14 days of departure, the deposit is non-refundable, but we will gladly move your booking to another date once, free of charge.
Cruises may be rerouted or paused for weather or safety reasons at the captain's discretion. In the rare event we must cancel entirely, you receive a full refund or a free reschedule — your choice.
Every guest joins at their own risk appropriate to a lake and rainforest environment. Life jackets must be worn during water activities. Children must be supervised by an adult at all times.
These terms are governed by the laws of Malaysia. Disputes are settled amicably first — we've never needed anything else.
